routes.retired_because: The externally known main conclusion supplies neither the formal gauge nor the unchanged-parameter comparison. It cannot certify this different proof.

C9000208.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 208 (Finite symmetric tensor categories and the Verlinde tower.; papers: Fiber functors for finite symmetric tensor categories in positive characteristic; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN_VERLINDE.statement: Every finite symmetric tensor category over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic has a fibre functor to some higher Verlinde category (thm:main).

C_FINITE_CONVENTIONS.statement: The finite category has simple unit and a projective generator with an exact faithful Hom functor (lem:finite-conventions).

C_EXACT_HIGHER_FROBENIUS.statement: A suitable embedding and least nonprojective tensor-power level yield an exact additive strong symmetric monoidal higher Frobenius functor (thm:exact-higher-frobenius).

C_FIRST_NONPROJECTIVE.statement: Some least level r has nonprojective M(r), with projective restrictions to every proper subgroup (prop:first-nonprojective); uses norm products, Chouinard, and the cited faithfulness inputs.

C_SUPPORT_SELECTION.statement: For a nonprojective E_r-module projective on proper subgroups, an embedding can be chosen so tensoring with the restricted Steinberg remains nonprojective (prop:support-selection); uses rank varieties, Steinberg support, and Moore selection.

C_THETA_DETECTION.statement: The stable restriction construction of Theta detects nonprojective restricted tiltings and annihilates proper-subgroup induced modules (lem:theta-detection), with projective evaluation (lem:projective-evaluation).

C_HIGHER_EXACTNESS.statement: Nonvanishing of Theta on a projective evaluation implies exactness of the internal higher Frobenius functor (prop:higher-exactness), using the cited O-functor and exactness criteria.

C_FINITE_DESCENT.statement: Ordinary Frobenius congruence and equality descent, followed by finite graph iteration, fibre the Serre closure of the exact part and combine tensor functors to one higher Verlinde category.

C_RESTRICTED_TILTING.statement: For every fixed embedding E_r into the original U(k) and every finite-dimensional kE_r-module D, R(St_(r-1)) tensor D is R(T) for a tilting SL2-module T (thm:restricted-tilting).

C_BOUNDED_ORIGIN.statement: Every kE_r-module is the e1 fibre of an SL2-equivariant bundle on the plane whose origin simple factors have highest weights below p^r (prop:bounded-origin).

C_BOUNDED_TILTING.statement: If every simple factor of M has highest weight below p^(m+1), St_m tensor M is tilting (lem:bounded-tilting); uses the cited SL2 tilting tensor-product formula.

C_FORMAL_COMPARE.statement: Every SL2-equivariant bundle on the standard plane with tilting origin fibre T has e1 fibre isomorphic over k to T restricted to the unchanged rational U action (lem:formal-comparison).

C_EXT_VANISH.statement: For every j >= 0 and tilting SL2-module T, Ext^1_G(T, Sym^j(V*) tensor T)=0 in rational G-modules; determinant multiplication gives the requisite good filtrations in every characteristic.

C_COMPATIBLE_JETS.statement: The Ext vanishing gives compatible equivariant splittings at all finite jet orders and hence an invertible formal gauge on the U-fixed line.

C_RATIONAL_SEPARATION.statement: Uniform polynomial dependence on the rational group parameter and separation of power-series coefficients turn all finite-jet equivariance equations into one polynomial matrix identity over k((x)).

C_COMPARE_ALGEBRA.statement: For arbitrary finite matrix size and all indexed action coefficients, the two transport identities and an invertible gauge give the unchanged-parameter intertwiner P^-1 H D; a nonsingular extension-field intertwiner descends to an infinite base field.
